input.summary:
Counting room furnished in parts/room-3.mjs: a dark-oak counting desk (focal, x3..6 z26, candles) with a keeper's stool, ledger shelves and barrel stock on the west wall, a fence tally post and a chest strongbox, and four hanging lanterns on chains. Clear lanes at z22 and x7 to the south door.</summary>
<parameter name="finished">true
left: Three floor cells sit at light 6-7 (x7 z22, x6 z28, x3 z31): dim, not dark, so the room tool reports OK, but short of the lamplighter's 8+ aim. One more hanging lantern near x3 z30 or x7 z22 would clear them.

Palette has no bookshelf, carpet, flower pot or bed, so the ledger shelves are slabs over barrels and the tally sticks are fence posts; the room reads as a counting office but weakly as a ledger room.
No plan.md or elements.md tick: the room designers have no checklist item, and the Counting room is only mentioned as a room in plan.md's RESERVED/FLOORS.
make.sh's whole-build check still shows floating shopfront/roof blocks (1848 cells) from other parts; not this room's cells.

waste.what: Drew the 7 furniture layers (10 rows x 5 columns each) by hand, then re-keyed the lantern and chain rows after an off-by-one in the row index (z22 vs z23, x3 vs x4).
waste.cost: two full rewrites of parts/room-3.mjs and one extra make.sh run
waste.tool: a `mcd plan --furnish` output that takes a per-room list of {block, x, y, z} and emits the layers() rows (or a legend-checked layers() that prints coordinates back) would have avoided the index mistake

waste.what: Lantern spots: the room tool suggests a standing lantern on the floor (6,5,27) that the palette cannot place cleanly under this design, so I tuned hanging lanterns by hand and re-ran make.sh to see the light map.
waste.cost: one extra make.sh run and one room check
waste.tool: `mcd room --suggest hanging` restricted to hung-from-chain spots at the ceiling, with the chain cells included in the output

waste.what: Checked the view by eye after one render; the room's light map and walk verdict were read from text rather than a single combined report.
waste.cost: one rooms render plus Read of room.png
waste.tool: `mcd room --png` in one call, with the walk verdict and light map in its JSON

companions.task: the wall shelving and tally rack: real bookshelf-like fittings for the ledger, and a proper counting desk with drawers, which the palette cannot express.
